facts.text: The hotel rises up among coffee and tea plantations.
facts.excerpt: The stunning Gran Meliá Arusha rises up among coffee and tea plantations.

facts.text: The hotel is located between the Serengeti and Kilimanjaro National Parks.
facts.excerpt: This spectacular hotel is located between the Serengeti and Kilimanjaro National Parks

facts.text: The hotel is 5 km from the city center.
facts.excerpt: 5 km fromCity center

facts.text: Rooms are decorated with motifs inspired by local Tanzanian tribes in the colors of local coffee beans.
facts.excerpt: Modern room inspired by local Tanzanian tribes and painted in the seductive colors of the local coffee beans.

facts.text: Mount Meru View rooms have a balcony overlooking the Mount Meru volcano and the hotel gardens.
facts.excerpt: With decoration inspired by local Tanzanian tribes, this room with balcony overlooks the Mount Meru volcano and the hotel gardens.

facts.text: The RedLevel Junior Suite has a balcony with views of Mount Meru and Arusha National Park, and a separate lounge.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy African sunsets from a balcony with spectacular views of Mount Meru and Arusha National Park. Sophisticated luxury and comfort in every element in a suite with a bedroom, separate lounge, and bathroom.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is on the top floor of the hotel, with large windows and pool views.
facts.excerpt: Located on the top floor of the hotel, this suite is elegance personified. A large 164m2 room with several different spaces, luxury fittings, large windows, and pool views.

facts.text: RedLevel guests have access to a private lounge with an open bar of premium-brand drinks from 5pm to 8pm.
facts.excerpt: an open-bar with premium-brand alcoholic beverages from 5pm to 8pm

facts.text: RedLevel benefits include a private check-in in the RedLevel Lounge and a personalized butler service on request.
facts.excerpt: a private check-in in the RedLevel Lounge and a personalized butler service (on request)

facts.text: RedLevel guests get an a la carte breakfast at the rooftop restaurant with panoramic views of Mount Meru.
facts.excerpt: Start the morning from our rooftop restaurant with panoramic views of Mount Meru.

facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool, an outdoor swimming pool, a rooftop area and Bali beds.
facts.excerpt:
- Rooftop area
- Signature restaurant
- Bali bed
- Infinity pool
- Outdoor swimming pool

facts.text: The Spa and Wellness Centre offers health and beauty treatments inspired by a combination of traditions and modern wellness techniques.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a wide range of health and beauty treatments inspired by a combination of traditions and modern wellness techniques to offer you the ultimate African experience.

facts.text: The Roof Top bar is on the top floor with views of Mount Meru, serving tapas, dishes to share and creative cocktails indoors and on the terrace.
facts.excerpt: With a great choice of tapas and dishes to share, both indoors and out on the terrace, all accompanied by creative cocktails.

facts.text: The Pool Bar is surrounded by the hotel's tea and coffee plantations, with Mount Meru as a backdrop.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in a Tanzanian ambiance, surrounded by our tea and coffee plantations, with Mount Meru as a backdrop.

facts.text: The Grill is the hotel's steakhouse restaurant.
facts.excerpt: The Grill Restaurant, where the art of steakhouse dining is elevated to new heights.

facts.text: The hotel offers a guided day trip into the Ngorongoro Crater, with a picnic lunch at the hippo pool.
facts.excerpt: Around midday, the journey reaches its peak with a picnic lunch at the scenic hippo pool

facts.text: The hotel offers a guided trek on Mount Meru, an active volcano of 4,566 metres.
facts.excerpt: Mount Meru, an active volcano standing at 4,566 metres, is a stunning trekking destination located just 70 kilometres west of Mount Kilimanjaro.

facts.text: A one-hour scenic flight over Mount Kilimanjaro departs from Arusha Airport, with only eight window seats.
facts.excerpt: With only eight window seats available, every passenger enjoys unobstructed views of the stunning scenery.

facts.text: A half-day trip to Arusha National Park explores the Montane forest and the Ngurdoto Crater.
facts.excerpt: Explore the vibrant Montane forest, the wildlife-rich Ngurdoto Crater, and serene lakeshores

facts.text: A day safari to Tarangire National Park departs from Arusha at dawn.
facts.excerpt: Experience a luxurious safari to Tarangire National Park, departing from Arusha at dawn.

facts.text: Experiences must be booked 48 hours in advance.
facts.excerpt: Bookings are required 48 hours in advance

facts.text: The Conference Center has a banqueting suite and five adaptable event rooms.
facts.excerpt: We offer a modern Conference Center with a banqueting suite and five adaptable event rooms

facts.text: City View rooms have a balcony with views over the city of Arusha.
facts.excerpt: an 86-inch TV, AC, and a balcony with views over the city of Arusha.

facts.text: The hotel is 48 km from the airport.
facts.excerpt: 48 km fromAirport
